title: mentha pulegium subsp. vulgaris
intro: Mentha pulegium subsp. vulgaris, commonly known as Pennyroyal, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include relieving digestive issues, such as nausea and bloating, and improving menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with PMS. The therapeutic actions of Pennyroyal are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including menthone, pulegone, and menthol, which exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pennyroyal also contribute to its ability to repel insects and improve cognitive function, although its use should be approached with caution due to potential toxicity.
